1.title: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
1.summary: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.

2.title: Three People Are Killed at a Minnesota Day Care Center
2.summary: The authorities in Hopkins, Minn., said two adults and a child, all family members, were killed at an in-home day care center.

3.title: ICE Agent Points Gun at Woman in Car in Virginia, Videos Show
3.summary: The agent accused the woman of trying to run him over with her vehicle, a claim she denied. It was the latest tense encounter between a federal agent and a driver.

4.title: Live Updates: Europe Counts Down to a Total Solar Eclipse
4.summary: From Iceland to Spain, people have flocked to places where, briefly, the moon will completely block the sun. It is the continent’s first total eclipse in decades.

6.title: Thousands of Canadians call for US ambassador's expulsion
6.summary: An online petition accusing Pete Hoekstra of diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs has garnered more than 60,000 signatures.
